title: Hot Spinach Artichoke Dip
description: A bubbling, cheesy baked dip of spinach and artichoke hearts in a garlicky cream cheese base, browned on top.

image.alt: A baking dish of bubbling spinach artichoke dip with chips

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, sour cream, mayonnaise, garlic and pepper flakes until smooth.
Stir in the spinach, artichokes, the Parmesan and half the mozzarella. Spread in the baking dish and top with the rest of the mozzarella.
Bake until bubbling at the edges and golden on top, {time 20-25 min}. Serve hot with chips, crackers or bread.

notes: Squeeze the spinach hard in a towel; leftover water makes a runny dip.
Traditional Parmesan is made with animal rennet. Use a vegetarian hard cheese to make this vegetarian.
Assemble up to a day ahead and bake straight from the fridge, adding 5 to 10 minutes.
